name: GPU Helper
description: Experimental iOS Metal compute mod with larger live gameplay diagnostics and GPU-assisted static decoration visibility culling, including reliable runtime enable/disable transitions.

debug-overlay.name: Show in-game GPU diagnostics overlay
debug-overlay.description: Show larger live GPU diagnostics including device, culling state, eligible objects, completed jobs, visible/culled counts, and timing. Larger text-only HUD with per-level batch state, actual completed Metal dispatches, visible/culled counts, processed-object totals, GPU time, CPU submit time, and fail-open state. No background panel.

gpu-decoration-culling.name: GPU-assisted static decoration culling
gpu-decoration-culling.description: Use Metal to test ungrouped static decoration bounds against the camera. The diagnostics show whether the GPU returned real visibility results. Cocos still draws visible objects; gameplay updates, triggers, collisions, and player physics remain on the normal game path. Experimental and fail-open if GPU work fails.
